generic.Defined scope/population: The full UAT rate test deck for the new product covering every launch state, coverage, and rating tier.
generic.In-scope period: The rate revision effective from the planned launch date through the first renewal cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every quote carries state, effective date, coverage limits, territory, tier, and calculated premium.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quote count and total premium from the engine run equal the expected premium file totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating validation results saved with engine build number, rate table version, and run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every premium variance raised as a Jira rating defect with root cause and fix or accepted rationale.
generic.Test population: All UAT deck quotes plus the minimum, maximum, and expiring-premium edge cases.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero premium variance against the expected file and no open Blocker or Critical rating defect.
generic.Exception handling path: Variances go to the Insurance Product Dev Lead for triage and re-run after the rate table correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premiums match the filed rate manual for every deck quote and the re-run shows zero drift.
generic.Evidence location: Signed rating validation results attached to the launch ticket in Jira.

steps.title: Load the approved rate tables into the policy administration system UAT environment
sop: Confirm the rate table package matches the version approved in the filing before loading.
Load product, rate, rule, and form configuration into the policy admin UAT environment.
Record the loaded build number and rate table version on the launch ticket.
Done when the UAT environment reports the approved rate table version active.
verify: Compare the active rate table version in policy admin against the approved package identifier.
Pass when the active version matches the approved package with no pending load errors.

steps.title: Assemble the UAT rate test deck and expected premium file
sop: Build test quotes covering every launch state, coverage combination, territory, and rating tier.
Calculate the expected premium for each quote directly from the filed rate manual.
Add explicit cases for minimum premium, maximum premium, and expiring-premium treatment.
Done when every deck row has a state, a rating scenario, and an expected premium value.
verify: Count deck rows per state and confirm each launch state and tier appears at least once.
Check that no expected premium cell is blank or carries a placeholder value.
Pass when the deck covers all launch states and every expected premium is populated.

steps.title: Execute the full rate test deck in the policy administration system
sop: Run every deck quote through the policy admin rating engine in a single controlled batch.
Export the engine output with quote identifier, rating inputs, and calculated premium.
Note any quote that errors or fails to rate rather than returning a premium.
Done when every deck quote has either a calculated premium or a recorded rating error.
verify: Reconcile the output record count against the deck row count.
Pass when the counts match and no quote is left without a result.

steps.title: Reconcile engine output to the expected premium file
sop: Join engine output to the expected premium file on quote identifier and compute the variance.
Isolate every non-zero variance and identify the rating factor or table that caused it.
Confirm minimum, maximum, and expiring-premium cases returned filed values rather than system defaults.
Done when every quote is marked matched or has a named causal factor recorded.
verify: Sum the absolute variance across the reconciled population.
Pass when the total absolute variance is zero and all edge cases return filed values.

steps.title: Audit rating factor, territory, and tier tables against the filed rate manual
sop: Extract each rating factor, territory, and tier table from the policy admin configuration.
Compare every value cell to the corresponding entry in the filed rate manual.
Record any table cell that differs from the filed value with its table name and key.
Done when every configured table cell has been compared to a filed manual value.
verify: Count table cells compared against total cells in the filed manual.
Pass when coverage is complete and no cell differs from the filed value.

steps.title: Raise and track rating defects in Jira
sop: Raise a Jira defect for each variance or table mismatch with the quote, factor, and expected value.
Set severity using the launch impact and link each defect to the launch ticket.
Track each defect to a code or configuration fix and confirm the fix is deployed to UAT.
Done when every variance has a Jira defect in a resolved or formally accepted state.
verify: Query Jira for open Blocker and Critical rating defects on the launch ticket.
Pass when the query returns zero open Blocker or Critical rating defects.

steps.title: Re-run the deck after the final rate table load and confirm zero drift
sop: Re-execute the full deck after the final rate table load rather than a targeted subset.
Compare the new premiums to both the expected file and the prior run output.
Investigate any quote whose premium moved between runs before accepting the result.
Done when the re-run output shows zero variance against the expected file and the prior run.
verify: Compute run-over-run variance across all deck quotes.
Pass when both the expected-file variance and the run-over-run variance are zero.

steps.title: Sign off and attach the rating validation results to the launch ticket
sop: Review the reconciliation output, table audit, and defect closure evidence.
Sign the rating validation results recording the engine build and rate table version.
Attach the signed pack to the launch ticket in Jira with the run timestamp.
Done when the signed validation pack is attached to the launch ticket.
verify: Open the launch ticket and confirm the attached pack carries a signature, build number, and date.
Pass when the signed pack is present and identifies the exact validated build.

generic.Defined scope/population: The production release build, product configuration, interfaces, and batch jobs for the new product.
generic.In-scope period: The deployment window from freeze entry through post-deployment confirmation on launch day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change ticket carries build number, window, back-out plan, approver, and CMDB references.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Production configuration item count matches the UAT-signed artifact manifest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation output stored against the change record with build number and validation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every configuration gap raised as an ITSM task with owner and pre-deployment resolution.
generic.Test population: All deployment artifacts, production product configuration items, interfaces, and batch jobs.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Build matches the UAT-signed artifact and every interface and batch job has a named CMDB owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatches block deployment and route to the Insurance Product Dev Lead for a rebuild or waiver.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved change record with an attached rollback plan and confirmed production configuration.
generic.Evidence location: Change record in the ITSM platform with validation evidence linked from Jira.

steps.title: Extract the UAT-signed artifact manifest from Jira
sop: Locate the UAT sign-off record on the launch ticket in Jira.
Extract the signed build number, artifact list, and configuration package version.
Record the manifest as the baseline for production validation.
Done when the signed manifest is recorded with its build number and sign-off date.
verify: Confirm the manifest carries a UAT sign-off signature and date.
Pass when a signed manifest with an unambiguous build number is recorded.

steps.title: Compare the production release build to the UAT-signed artifact
sop: Query the production deployment package for its build number and artifact checksums.
Compare each value against the UAT-signed manifest entry by entry.
Halt the validation and escalate if any artifact differs from the signed version.
Done when every production artifact has been compared to its signed counterpart.
verify: Count matched artifacts against total artifacts in the manifest.
Pass when every artifact matches and no unmatched artifact remains.

steps.title: Verify product, rate, and form configuration is active in production policy admin
sop: Query the production policy admin environment for the new product code and its effective dates.
Confirm rate tables and form editions are present and in an active status.
List any configuration item that is missing, inactive, or dated incorrectly.
Done when every expected product, rate, and form item is confirmed present and active.
verify: Reconcile the active production configuration item count to the manifest count.
Pass when counts reconcile and no expected item is missing or inactive.

steps.title: Confirm CMDB entries exist for the new product interfaces and batch jobs
sop: List every interface and batch job the new product introduces or changes.
Look each one up in the CMDB and confirm a configuration item exists.
Confirm each configuration item carries a named support owner and support group.
Done when every interface and batch job has a CMDB entry with a named owner.
verify: Count interfaces and batch jobs with a CMDB entry and an owner against the full list.
Pass when every item is registered and no owner field is empty.

steps.title: Record the deployment window, freeze exception, and back-out plan on the change ticket
sop: Raise or update the change record in the ITSM platform for the production deployment.
Enter the agreed deployment window and attach the freeze exception approval if required.
Attach the back-out plan naming the trigger, the steps, and the decision owner.
Done when the change ticket carries the window, freeze exception, and back-out plan.
verify: Open the change record and check the window, exception, and back-out attachments.
Pass when all three are present and the back-out plan names a decision owner.

steps.title: Log configuration gaps as ITSM tasks with pre-deployment due dates
sop: Raise an ITSM task for every missing configuration item, CMDB gap, or artifact mismatch.
Assign each task an owner and a due date ahead of the deployment window.
Track the tasks to closure and re-verify the affected item after each fix.
Done when every logged gap is closed or carries a recorded acceptance.
verify: Query open gap tasks linked to the change record.
Pass when no gap task remains open with a due date inside the deployment window.

steps.title: Obtain change approval for the production deployment
sop: Review the artifact comparison, configuration validation, and CMDB evidence.
Confirm the back-out plan is executable within the deployment window.
Approve the change record in the ITSM platform and record the approval rationale.
Done when the change record is in an approved state with the rollback plan attached.
verify: Check the change record status and the presence of the attached rollback plan.
Pass when the record is approved and the rollback plan is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every rate, rule, and form filing supporting the new product in each planned launch state.
generic.In-scope period: Filings with approved effective dates on or before the planned product launch date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each filing carries a SERFF tracking number, disposition, approval date, and effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved form numbers and editions in SERFF equal those configured in policy admin.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: SERFF disposition letters saved per state with the filing version and disposition date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States filed but not approved removed from launch scope with the removal reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All launch states and every rate, rule, and form filing supporting them.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No launch state in a disposition other than closed-approved at the verification date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unapproved states drop from launch scope and route to the Insurance Product Manager for rescoping.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closed-approved disposition per launch state with effective dates on or before launch.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF disposition letters filed against the launch record with the state scope list.

steps.title: Pull the SERFF filing status report for the product
sop: Run the SERFF filing status report across all filings tied to the new product.
Capture tracking number, state, filing type, disposition, and disposition date per row.
Export the report with the pull timestamp for the evidence pack.
Done when a dated status report covering every product filing is exported.
verify: Confirm the report includes a row for every planned launch state.
Pass when no launch state is absent from the report.

steps.title: Confirm a closed-approved disposition for every launch state
sop: Review the disposition value for each launch state in the SERFF report.
Mark any state that is filed, pending, or objected as not approved.
Record the tracking number and disposition date for each approved state.
Done when every launch state carries an approved or not-approved determination.
verify: Count states with a closed-approved disposition against the launch state list.
Pass when every remaining launch state is closed-approved.

steps.title: Match approved form numbers and editions to policy admin configuration
sop: List the approved form numbers and edition dates from each SERFF disposition.
Query the policy administration system for the forms configured against the product.
Flag any form configured with an edition date that was not approved for that state.
Done when every configured form is matched to an approved form and edition.
verify: Reconcile configured form count to approved form count per state.
Pass when the counts reconcile and no unmatched edition remains.

steps.title: Confirm approved effective dates fall on or before the launch date
sop: Read the approved effective date from each state disposition.
Compare each date against the planned product launch date.
Flag any state whose approved effective date falls after the launch date.
Done when every launch state has its effective date compared to the launch date.
verify: List states with an effective date later than the launch date.
Pass when that list is empty for the final launch scope.

steps.title: Remove unapproved states from launch scope and record the removal
sop: Remove any state that is filed but not approved from the launch state list.
Record the removal reason, the expected approval date, and the re-entry trigger.
Notify distribution and operations that the state is out of the initial launch scope.
Done when the launch state list contains only approved states and removals are recorded.
verify: Compare the revised launch state list against the approved state list.
Pass when the two lists are identical and each removal has a recorded reason.

steps.title: Record state objections and their resolutions
sop: Extract every objection letter and condition attached to the state filings in SERFF.
Record what each objection required and the response filed to resolve it.
Flag any condition that imposes an ongoing obligation after approval.
Done when every objection has a recorded resolution and any ongoing condition is flagged.
verify: Count objections recorded against objections present in the SERFF filings.
Pass when every objection is recorded with a resolution.

steps.title: File the approval evidence pack against the launch record
sop: Assemble disposition letters, the status report, and the objection log into one pack.
Record the final approved launch state list and its version date on the pack cover.
File the pack against the launch record for the product governance evidence set.
Done when the filed pack contains disposition evidence for every launch state.
verify: Open the pack and confirm one disposition letter per launch state plus the state list.
Pass when the pack is complete and the state list matches the dispositions.

generic.Defined scope/population: All go-live readiness evidence for the launch including checklist, minutes, and sign-off sheet.
generic.In-scope period: From readiness assessment start through the recorded go/no-go decision date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each archived item carries a document title, author, version, and approval date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived document count matches the readiness evidence index for the launch.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Record set carries the product-governance retention label and upload timestamps per file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every missing evidence item logged with its owner and either supplied or formally waived.
generic.Test population: All items on the readiness evidence index for this product launch.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Complete evidence pack present with the retention label applied and the record set locked.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing items escalate to the Implementation Specialist and block locking of the record set.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pack contains UAT rating results, filing approvals, and support readiness confirmations.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint launch record set linked to the launch entry in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Build the readiness evidence index for the launch
sop: List every evidence item the readiness assessment required with its expected owner.
Mark each item as received, outstanding, or not applicable with a reason.
Record the index in the SharePoint launch record set as the archive control list.
Done when every expected evidence item appears on the index with a status.
verify: Compare the index against the readiness criteria list for coverage.
Pass when every readiness criterion has at least one indexed evidence item.

steps.title: Upload the readiness checklist, minutes, and sign-off sheet to SharePoint
sop: Upload the completed readiness checklist into the launch record set.
Upload the go/no-go minutes and the signed sign-off sheet alongside it.
Set the document title, version, and approval date properties on each file.
Done when all three documents are uploaded with their properties populated.
verify: Open each uploaded file and confirm its version and approval date properties.
Pass when all three files are present with complete properties.

steps.title: Confirm the pack contains rating, filing, and support readiness evidence
sop: Check that the signed UAT rating validation results are in the record set.
Check that the state filing approval evidence pack is in the record set.
Check that the support readiness and training confirmations are in the record set.
Done when all three evidence categories are confirmed present in the pack.
verify: Reconcile the uploaded document list to the evidence index entry by entry.
Pass when no indexed item is missing from the record set.

steps.title: Apply the product-governance retention label to the archived folder
sop: Open the launch record set library settings in SharePoint.
Apply the product-governance retention label to the archived launch folder.
Confirm the label inherits to every document already in the folder.
Done when the retention label shows on the folder and its contents.
verify: Spot-check documents in the folder for the applied retention label.
Pass when every checked document carries the product-governance label.

steps.title: Link the archived evidence pack to the launch entry in the GRC platform
sop: Open the product launch entry in the GRC platform.
Add the SharePoint record set link as the evidence reference for the launch.
Record the archive date and the responsible owner on the GRC entry.
Done when the GRC launch entry resolves to the archived record set.
verify: Follow the GRC evidence link and confirm it opens the correct record set.
Pass when the link resolves to the launch record set with the retention label.

steps.title: Log and chase outstanding evidence items
sop: List every index item still outstanding with its owner and due date.
Chase each owner and record the supplied document or the waiver decision.
Escalate items still outstanding after the agreed chase period.
Done when no index item remains outstanding without a supplied file or a waiver.
verify: Filter the index for outstanding items without a disposition.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

steps.title: Lock the record set to read-only once the pack is complete
sop: Confirm the evidence index shows no outstanding item before locking.
Set the launch record set permissions to read-only for all groups.
Record the lock date and the person who applied it on the GRC launch entry.
Done when the record set is read-only and the lock is recorded in GRC.
verify: Attempt an edit on a locked document to confirm write access is blocked.
Pass when the record set rejects edits and the lock date is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: All supervisors and team leaders across servicing, claims, contact centre, and distribution.
generic.In-scope period: The briefing window from schedule publication to the day before go-live.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: LMS attendance rows carry attendee name, team, session date, and completion status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: LMS attendance count equals the required supervisor roster count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Briefing deck and escalation matrix stored with version and delivery date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every absent supervisor logged with a booked catch-up session date.
generic.Test population: The full required supervisor roster for the launch.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No required supervisor with incomplete LMS attendance at the go-live date.
generic.Exception handling path: Absentees route to the Distribution Operations Manager for a catch-up session or cover.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every supervisor briefed on the launch timeline, escalation matrix, and runbook location.
generic.Evidence location: LMS attendance record plus the briefing pack in the SharePoint launch site.

steps.title: Build the required supervisor roster from the launch site list
sop: List every supervisor and team leader in scope across servicing, claims, contact centre, and distribution.
Record each person's team, site, and shift pattern for scheduling.
Confirm the roster with each functional lead before scheduling sessions.
Done when the confirmed roster names every supervisor required to attend.
verify: Cross-check the roster against the launch-week rota for uncovered teams.
Pass when every in-scope team has at least one named supervisor on the roster.

steps.title: Prepare the supervisor briefing pack in SharePoint
sop: Build the briefing covering the launch-day timeline, cut-over steps, and known workarounds.
Include the escalation matrix with named contacts and response commitments.
Include the runbook location and the launch-period incident hotline number.
Done when the versioned briefing pack is published to the SharePoint launch site.
verify: Review the pack against the runbook for timeline and escalation consistency.
Pass when the pack matches the approved runbook with no conflicting steps.

steps.title: Schedule briefing sessions in the learning management system
sop: Create the supervisor briefing course in the learning management system.
Schedule sessions covering every shift pattern on the roster.
Enrol each rostered supervisor and issue the calendar invitations.
Done when every rostered supervisor is enrolled in a scheduled session.
verify: Compare LMS enrolment count to the roster count.
Pass when the counts match and no rostered supervisor is unenrolled.

steps.title: Deliver the briefing on launch-day timeline and cut-over steps
sop: Walk supervisors through the hour-by-hour launch-day timeline and cut-over steps.
Cover the known-issue workarounds and when each applies.
Take and record questions that cannot be answered in session for follow-up.
Done when the timeline and workaround content has been delivered to each session.
verify: Review session notes for unanswered questions still open.
Pass when every logged question has an answer issued to attendees.

steps.title: Walk supervisors through the escalation matrix and response commitments
sop: Present the escalation matrix naming each contact, route, and out-of-hours cover.
State the response and resolution commitments that apply during the launch period.
Confirm supervisors know which issues escalate immediately versus at the daily checkpoint.
Done when every session has covered the matrix and the response commitments.
verify: Sample supervisors on the correct escalation route for a Priority 1 launch issue.
Pass when sampled supervisors name the correct route and contact.

steps.title: Confirm supervisors can locate the runbook and incident hotline
sop: Have each supervisor open the runbook from the SharePoint launch site in session.
Have each supervisor record the launch-period incident hotline in their own contacts.
Note any supervisor lacking access to the launch site and raise the access request.
Done when every attendee has opened the runbook and holds the hotline number.
verify: Check outstanding launch site access requests for supervisors.
Pass when no supervisor is left without launch site access.

steps.title: Record attendance in the LMS and book catch-up sessions for absentees
sop: Mark attendance for every session in the learning management system.
Identify rostered supervisors who did not attend and contact each one.
Book a catch-up session for each absentee before the go-live date.
Done when every absentee has a booked catch-up session recorded in the LMS.
verify: Run the LMS completion report against the required supervisor roster.
Pass when no required supervisor shows incomplete attendance.

generic.Defined scope/population: All impacted internal teams, appointed agents and brokers, and named third parties.
generic.In-scope period: From go-live confirmation through the first week of the launch period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every notice states the effective date, the states in scope, and the issue-raising route.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Distribution list recipient count matches the impacted stakeholder register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent notices and portal posts retained with send timestamp and content version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounced or undelivered recipients logged and re-issued through an alternate route.
generic.Test population: All internal distribution lists, portal audiences, and named third-party contacts.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Published launch notice showing the effective date and state list with no unreached audience.
generic.Exception handling path: Undelivered notices route to the Distribution Operations Manager for alternate delivery.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every impacted audience has received a dated notice naming states and support contacts.
generic.Evidence location: Sent-items evidence in SharePoint plus the published notice on the Broker and Agent Portal.

steps.title: Confirm the final effective date and launch state list
sop: Take the approved effective date and launch state list from the recorded launch decision.
Confirm no state has been removed from scope since the decision was minuted.
Record the confirmed date and state list as the basis for all communications.
Done when the confirmed effective date and state list are recorded for use in the notice.
verify: Compare the confirmed state list against the filing approval evidence pack.
Pass when the state list matches the approved filings exactly.

steps.title: Build the impacted stakeholder register in SharePoint
sop: List the internal distribution lists for servicing, claims, contact centre, and distribution.
List the broker and agent portal audiences that must see the launch notice.
List the named third parties including print vendor, bureau, and MGA contacts.
Done when the register names every audience with its delivery route and contact.
verify: Cross-check the register against the readiness assessment stakeholder list.
Pass when no readiness stakeholder is absent from the register.

steps.title: Draft the go-live confirmation notice and product summary
sop: Draft the notice stating the effective date, the states in scope, and what changes for each audience.
State the route for raising launch issues and the support contacts by function.
Attach the product summary describing coverages, eligibility, and key rating drivers.
Done when the drafted notice carries the date, state list, and issue-raising route.
verify: Review the draft for the required date, state list, and support contact elements.
Pass when all three elements are present and consistent with the launch decision.

steps.title: Issue the confirmation to internal distribution lists
sop: Send the go-live confirmation to the servicing, claims, contact centre, and distribution lists.
Save the sent notice and its timestamp to the SharePoint launch record set.
Monitor for delivery failures and record any list that did not receive the notice.
Done when every internal distribution list has been sent the confirmation.
verify: Reconcile sent notices to the internal audiences on the stakeholder register.
Pass when every internal audience has a recorded send with a timestamp.

steps.title: Publish the launch notice to the Broker and Agent Portal
sop: Publish the launch notice and product summary to the broker and agent portal.
Confirm the published page shows the effective date and the states in scope.
Set the notice to appear on the portal landing page for the launch period.
Done when the notice is live and visible to the intended portal audiences.
verify: Open the portal as a broker user and locate the published notice.
Pass when the notice is visible showing the effective date and state list.

steps.title: Notify named third parties with the effective date and support contacts
sop: Send the tailored notice to the print vendor, bureau, and MGA contacts on the register.
State the effective date, the states in scope, and the operational support contacts.
Request an acknowledgement from each third party and record the reply.
Done when every named third party has been notified and asked to acknowledge.
verify: Compare received acknowledgements to the third-party list on the register.
Pass when every named third party has acknowledged or has an escalation logged.

steps.title: Log undelivered notices and re-issue through an alternate route
sop: Collect delivery failures, bounces, and unacknowledged third parties.
Record each with its audience, cause, and the alternate delivery route chosen.
Re-issue the notice through the alternate route and confirm receipt.
Done when no audience on the register remains without a confirmed receipt.
verify: Filter the register for audiences without a confirmed receipt.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every readiness criterion covering rating, filings, systems, training, support, and communications.
generic.In-scope period: From assessment kick-off to the assessment sign-off date ahead of go/no-go.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each criterion carries a status, an evidence link, a named owner, and a resolution date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assessed criterion count equals the approved product-approval gate checklist count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scored assessment saved in SharePoint with its version and assessment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every amber or red criterion logged with an owner, action, and pre-launch resolution date.
generic.Test population: All readiness criteria on the approved product-approval gate checklist.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No unresolved red criterion at the assessment date and every amber item has a dated owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Red criteria escalate to the Insurance Product Manager for resolution or a launch date change.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every criterion scored against linked evidence with residual risks recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Assessment record in the PPM tool with the scored sheet in the SharePoint launch record set.

steps.title: Extract the readiness criteria from the approved product-approval gate checklist
sop: Pull the approved product-approval gate checklist from the PPM tool.
List each criterion under rating, filings, systems, training, support, and communications.
Record the criterion list in the assessment sheet on the SharePoint launch site.
Done when every gate checklist criterion appears once on the assessment sheet.
verify: Reconcile the assessment sheet criterion count to the gate checklist count.
Pass when the counts reconcile with no criterion omitted.

steps.title: Collect the evidence link for each readiness criterion
sop: Request the supporting evidence from the owning team for each criterion.
Record a resolvable link to the evidence against each criterion row.
Mark criteria where the evidence supplied does not address the criterion.
Done when every criterion has an evidence link or a recorded evidence gap.
verify: Open a sample of evidence links and confirm each addresses its criterion.
Pass when sampled links resolve and match the criterion they support.

steps.title: Score each criterion red, amber, or green with the owning team
sop: Score each criterion red, amber, or green against the evidence supplied.
Confirm each score with the owning team rather than assigning it unilaterally.
Record the reason for every amber or red score on the criterion row.
Done when every criterion carries a confirmed score with a reason where not green.
verify: Filter for criteria scored amber or red without a recorded reason.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

steps.title: Assign an owner and resolution date to every amber and red item
sop: Assign a named owner to every amber and red criterion.
Agree a resolution date that falls before the planned launch date.
Raise a tracked action in Jira for each item and link it to the criterion row.
Done when every amber and red item has an owner, a date, and a Jira action.
verify: Query Jira actions linked to the assessment for missing owners or dates.
Pass when every action carries an owner and a pre-launch due date.

steps.title: Reconcile the scored criteria back to the gate checklist
sop: Compare the scored assessment sheet against the approved gate checklist line by line.
Confirm no gate criterion is unscored and no extra criterion has been introduced.
Record any deviation from the gate checklist with the reason it was made.
Done when the scored sheet and the gate checklist reconcile line by line.
verify: List gate criteria absent from the assessment and assessment rows absent from the gate.
Pass when both lists are empty or every difference has a recorded reason.

steps.title: Capture the assessment outcome and residual risks in the launch record
sop: Write the overall readiness position with the count of red, amber, and green criteria.
Record the residual risks that will remain open at launch and their mitigations.
Save the assessment to the SharePoint launch record set with its version and date.
Done when the launch record carries the dated outcome and the residual risk list.
verify: Open the launch record and confirm the outcome, counts, and residual risks are present.
Pass when all three are recorded with the assessment date.

steps.title: Confirm no unresolved red criterion remains at the assessment date
sop: Re-check every criterion scored red for evidence that it has been resolved.
Escalate any criterion still red and decide whether it blocks the launch date.
Record the decision and, where the red stands, the impact on launch scope.
Done when no criterion is red without a recorded escalation decision.
verify: Filter the assessment for red criteria without a resolution or escalation decision.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The hypercare rota, launch incident queue, routing rules, and help-desk knowledge content.
generic.In-scope period: The launch hypercare period from go-live day to the agreed step-down date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rota rows carry site, shift, named floor-walker, and contact number for each launch day.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rota coverage count equals the sites multiplied by the shifts across the hypercare period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rota, routing configuration, and target agreement saved with version and approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every uncovered shift or routing gap logged with an owner and a cover decision before go-live.
generic.Test population: All hypercare shifts, ITSM routing rules, and published help-desk articles for the product.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Dedicated launch queue live with an assignment group populated and no uncovered shift.
generic.Exception handling path: Uncovered shifts escalate to the Distribution Operations Manager for cover reassignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Named cover per site and shift with live routing and published knowledge content.
generic.Evidence location: ITSM queue configuration plus the approved rota in the SharePoint launch record set.

steps.title: Build the hypercare rota with named floor-walkers per site and shift
sop: List every site and shift that requires floor-walker cover during the hypercare period.
Assign a named floor-walker and a contact number to each site and shift.
Publish the rota to the SharePoint launch record set with its version and date.
Done when every site and shift in the hypercare period has a named floor-walker.
verify: Count covered shifts against sites multiplied by shifts across the period.
Pass when the counts reconcile with no uncovered shift.

steps.title: Confirm floor-walker availability with the operations leads
sop: Send each operations lead the rota entries covering their team.
Ask each lead to confirm the named individuals are released for those shifts.
Replace any name the lead cannot release and reissue the affected rota entry.
Done when every rota entry is confirmed by the responsible operations lead.
verify: Compare received confirmations against the rota entries per team.
Pass when every rota entry carries a lead confirmation.

steps.title: Create the dedicated launch incident queue in the ITSM platform
sop: Create the launch incident queue in the ITSM platform for the hypercare period.
Populate the assignment group with the hypercare support members.
Set the queue visible to the contact centre, servicing, and claims intake teams.
Done when the queue is live with a populated assignment group.
verify: Open the queue configuration and check the assignment group membership.
Pass when the queue is active and the assignment group is not empty.

steps.title: Configure routing rules and priority definitions for launch incidents
sop: Configure routing so incidents tagged with the new product code reach the launch queue.
Set the priority definitions that apply to launch incidents during hypercare.
Raise a test incident against the product code and confirm it routes correctly.
Done when a test incident routes to the launch queue at the expected priority.
verify: Check the test incident record for its assigned queue and priority.
Pass when the test incident landed in the launch queue at the correct priority.

steps.title: Publish and check the help-desk knowledge article for the new product
sop: Publish the product knowledge article covering common questions and known workarounds.
Confirm the article is searchable by the product name and product code.
Link the article to the launch incident queue as the first-response reference.
Done when the published article returns on a search for the product name.
verify: Search the knowledge base as a help-desk user for the product name and code.
Pass when the article returns on both searches in a published state.

steps.title: Agree and record launch-period response and resolution targets
sop: Agree the response and resolution targets that apply to launch incidents by priority.
Record the targets against the launch queue configuration in the ITSM platform.
Publish the targets to the support teams alongside the rota on the launch site.
Done when the agreed targets are recorded against the queue and published.
verify: Open the queue configuration and the published rota for the stated targets.
Pass when the targets match in both locations for every priority.

steps.title: Escalate and close out uncovered shifts before go-live
sop: List every shift still without confirmed floor-walker cover.
Escalate each gap to the site lead and agree cover or a documented reduced-cover decision.
Update the rota and reissue it to the support teams after each change.
Done when no shift remains uncovered without a recorded decision.
verify: Filter the final rota for shifts without a named floor-walker.
Pass when the filtered list is empty or each gap carries a recorded decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Operations, claims, contact centre, and IT support leads plus all floor-walk stations.
generic.In-scope period: From runbook approval to the read-acknowledgement deadline before launch day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each acknowledgement carries the lead name, team, runbook version, and acknowledgement date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledgement count equals the recipient list count for the distributed version.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published runbook carries its version and approval date with earlier versions marked superseded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Leads who have not acknowledged logged and chased with the escalation recorded.
generic.Test population: All named team leads on the distribution list plus every floor-walk station.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Current runbook version marked approved with a complete acknowledgement list attached.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing acknowledgements escalate to the Distribution Operations Manager before launch day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every lead has acknowledged the current approved runbook version before go-live.
generic.Evidence location: Approved runbook in Confluence with the acknowledgement list in the SharePoint launch record set.

steps.title: Publish the approved runbook version to the Confluence launch space
sop: Publish the approved runbook to the Confluence launch space with its version number.
Record the approval date and the approvers on the runbook page header.
Restrict edit rights so the published version cannot change without a new approval.
Done when the approved runbook is published with its version and approval date visible.
verify: Open the published page and check the version, approval date, and edit restrictions.
Pass when the page shows an approved version and is protected from edits.

steps.title: Mark earlier runbook versions superseded
sop: Locate every earlier runbook version in Confluence and the SharePoint launch site.
Mark each one superseded and add a link to the current approved version.
Remove earlier versions from any location that support teams browse for the current copy.
Done when no earlier version is reachable without a superseded marking.
verify: Search Confluence and SharePoint for runbook copies without a superseded marking.
Pass when only the current approved version returns as current.

steps.title: Build the runbook distribution list of team leads
sop: List the operations, claims, contact centre, and IT support leads who must receive the runbook.
Record each lead's name, team, and site against the distribution list.
Confirm the list with each function so no in-scope team is missing a named lead.
Done when the distribution list names a lead for every in-scope team.
verify: Cross-check the distribution list against the hypercare rota teams.
Pass when every team on the rota has a named lead on the distribution list.

steps.title: Send the runbook link to the distribution list
sop: Send the Confluence runbook link to every lead on the distribution list.
State the runbook version, the acknowledgement deadline, and how to acknowledge.
Save the sent message and its timestamp to the SharePoint launch record set.
Done when every lead on the distribution list has been sent the runbook link.
verify: Reconcile sent recipients to the distribution list entries.
Pass when every listed lead has a recorded send with a timestamp.

steps.title: Collect read-acknowledgements from each team lead
sop: Collect an acknowledgement from each lead naming the runbook version they read.
Record the lead name, team, version, and acknowledgement date on the tracking list.
Reject acknowledgements that reference a superseded runbook version.
Done when every lead has acknowledged the current approved runbook version.
verify: Count acknowledgements for the current version against the distribution list count.
Pass when the counts match with no acknowledgement citing an older version.

steps.title: Place printed runbook copies at each floor-walk station
sop: Print the current approved runbook version for each contact-centre floor-walk station.
Place a copy at each station and mark it with the version and print date.
Remove any earlier printed copy found at a station.
Done when every floor-walk station holds a current printed copy and no older copy.
verify: Walk each station and check the version marked on the printed copy.
Pass when every station holds the current version and no superseded print remains.

steps.title: Chase and escalate outstanding acknowledgements before launch day
sop: List leads who have not acknowledged by the deadline with their team and site.
Chase each lead directly and escalate to their function head where no reply follows.
Record the chase, the escalation, and the outcome against each outstanding lead.
Done when no lead remains unacknowledged without a recorded escalation.
verify: Filter the tracking list for leads without an acknowledgement or an escalation record.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The launch metric set covering quote volume, bind rate, referral rate, error rate, and handle time.
generic.In-scope period: From go-live day through the date reporting steps down to business as usual.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each metric carries a definition, a source table, a target threshold, and a refresh schedule.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dashboard volumes for the new product code reconcile to the warehouse source counts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dashboard definition and threshold set saved with version and effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics returning no data or failing refresh logged with owner and remediation.
generic.Test population: All launch metrics for the new product code across the first reporting cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Dashboard published for the new product code with a scheduled refresh enabled.
generic.Exception handling path: Refresh failures and zero-volume metrics escalate to the Insurance Product Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Daily dashboard and review cadence live with a defined step-down date to business as usual.
generic.Evidence location: Published dashboard in the BI reporting platform with the metric definitions attached.

steps.title: Define the launch metric set with target thresholds
sop: Define quote volume, bind rate, referral rate, error rate, and handle time for the new product.
Set a target threshold and an alert level for each metric.
Record each metric definition with its calculation and source table.
Done when every launch metric has a definition, a source, and a target threshold.
verify: Review each metric definition for a stated calculation and threshold.
Pass when no metric lacks a calculation or a threshold.

steps.title: Confirm the warehouse carries the new product code
sop: Query the enterprise data warehouse for the new product code in the policy and quote tables.
Confirm the code flows through from the policy admin feed without transformation loss.
Raise a data feed issue where the code is absent or mapped to a legacy value.
Done when the product code is confirmed present in every source table the metrics use.
verify: Run a count by product code across the source tables the metrics reference.
Pass when the new product code returns in every referenced source table.

steps.title: Build the launch dashboard in the BI reporting platform
sop: Build the dashboard with one panel per launch metric filtered to the new product code.
Show the target threshold alongside the actual value on each panel.
Publish the dashboard to the launch audience with view permissions set.
Done when the dashboard is published showing every launch metric for the product code.
verify: Open the published dashboard and check each metric panel renders a value.
Pass when every panel renders and the product code filter is applied.

steps.title: Schedule the daily dashboard refresh
sop: Set the dashboard to refresh daily ahead of the standing review time.
Configure a refresh failure alert to the metric owner.
Run the refresh once manually and confirm it completes within the review window.
Done when the daily refresh is scheduled and a manual run has completed successfully.
verify: Check the refresh history for a successful run and the schedule status.
Pass when the schedule is enabled and the last run completed successfully.

steps.title: Schedule the standing daily review for the first two weeks
sop: Book the standing daily launch review for the first two weeks after go-live.
Invite product, operations, distribution, and support representatives.
State the dashboard as the single input and the escalation route for breached thresholds.
Done when the daily review series is booked with the required attendees invited.
verify: Open the calendar series and check the dates, attendees, and dashboard link.
Pass when the series covers the first two weeks with all functions invited.

steps.title: Set the weekly scorecard distribution and the step-down date
sop: Define the weekly scorecard content and its distribution list.
Schedule the scorecard to issue weekly from the BI reporting platform.
Record the date the daily cadence steps down to business-as-usual reporting.
Done when the weekly scorecard is scheduled and the step-down date is recorded.
verify: Check the scorecard schedule and the recorded step-down date.
Pass when both are set and the step-down date follows the daily review period.

steps.title: Confirm day-one non-zero volumes and log data exceptions
sop: On day one check every metric panel returns a non-zero or explainable value.
Log any metric returning no data with its likely cause and an owner.
Fix or re-point the metric source and re-check on the next refresh.
Done when every launch metric returns a value or has a logged remediation owner.
verify: List launch metrics returning no data after the day-one refresh.
Pass when the list is empty or each entry carries a remediation owner and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The launch-day timeline from cut-over start to end-of-day confirmation across all involved teams.
generic.In-scope period: Go-live day from the cut-over window opening to the end-of-day confirmation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each runbook step names an accountable team, a system, and an expected completion time.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Runbook step count matches the cut-over plan step count from the change record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Runbook stored in Confluence with a version, author, and review sign-off date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every review comment logged and either incorporated or answered before issue.
generic.Test population: All launch-day steps, known-issue workarounds, and escalation contacts.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Runbook contains the timeline, RACI, escalation matrix, and back-out trigger.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved review comments block issue and escalate to the Insurance Product Dev Lead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Operations, IT, and product have each signed off the runbook before issue.
generic.Evidence location: Runbook page in Confluence with the review sign-off record in SharePoint.

steps.title: Draft the hour-by-hour launch-day timeline in Confluence
sop: Draft the timeline from cut-over start through to the end-of-day confirmation.
Place each step at a specific clock time rather than a relative offset.
Include the checkpoints where a go or hold decision is taken during the day.
Done when every launch-day activity appears on the timeline at a stated time.
verify: Walk the timeline for gaps between consecutive steps and unassigned time blocks.
Pass when the timeline runs unbroken from cut-over start to end-of-day.

steps.title: Assign an accountable team, system, and completion time to each step
sop: Name the accountable team for each timeline step.
Record the system the step is performed in and the expected completion time.
Confirm each assignment with the team named before publishing the draft.
Done when every step names a team, a system, and an expected completion time.
verify: Filter the step list for rows missing a team, system, or completion time.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

steps.title: Document known-issue workarounds from the UAT defect log
sop: List every open known issue carried into launch from the UAT defect log.
Write the workaround, who applies it, and how the affected case is later corrected.
Note the fix date planned for each known issue after launch.
Done when every carried-forward known issue has a documented workaround.
verify: Compare the documented workarounds to the open defects carried into launch.
Pass when every carried-forward defect has a workaround in the runbook.

steps.title: Define the back-out trigger and its decision owner
sop: State the observable conditions that trigger a back-out decision.
Name the individual who owns the back-out decision and their deputy.
Reference the back-out steps recorded on the change record and the time they need.
Done when the runbook states the trigger, the decision owner, and the back-out steps.
verify: Check the runbook back-out section against the change record rollback plan.
Pass when the trigger, owner, and steps are stated and consistent with the change record.

steps.title: Include the escalation matrix with out-of-hours cover
sop: Add the escalation matrix listing names, roles, numbers, and escalation order.
Record out-of-hours cover for every function involved on launch day.
Confirm each named contact has agreed to be on the matrix for the launch period.
Done when every function on the timeline has a named contact and out-of-hours cover.
verify: Cross-check the matrix functions against the teams named on the timeline.
Pass when every timeline team has an escalation contact and out-of-hours cover.

steps.title: Reconcile the runbook steps to the change record cut-over plan
sop: Compare the runbook step list against the cut-over plan on the change record.
Add any cut-over step missing from the runbook and remove steps not in the plan.
Record any deliberate difference with the reason it exists.
Done when the runbook and cut-over plan reconcile step for step.
verify: Count runbook steps against cut-over plan steps and list the differences.
Pass when the counts reconcile or each difference has a recorded reason.

steps.title: Obtain review sign-off from operations, IT, and product
sop: Circulate the draft runbook to operations, IT, and product reviewers.
Log every review comment and record whether it was incorporated or answered.
Collect a dated sign-off from each of the three functions before issue.
Done when all three functions have signed off and no comment is unresolved.
verify: Check the sign-off record for three dated approvals and an empty open-comment list.
Pass when all three sign-offs are present and no comment remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every readiness criterion and pre-launch condition from the product approval gate.
generic.In-scope period: The go/no-go review window ahead of the planned launch effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each criterion carries a status, evidence link, owning function, and confirmed position.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Positions recorded equal the number of accountable functions invited to the review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Minutes stored with attendance, decision, date, and the readiness assessment version reviewed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every dissent and condition recorded with an owner and a due date before closing.
generic.Test population: All accountable functions and all product approval gate pre-launch conditions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Minuted decision showing the named approver and a recorded position from each function.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmet conditions route to the Chief Product Officer for waiver or launch deferral.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each criterion confirmed against evidence with an explicit position from every function.
generic.Evidence location: Go/no-go minutes in SharePoint linked to the launch record in the PPM tool.

steps.title: Circulate the readiness assessment and gate conditions before the review
sop: Send the scored readiness assessment and evidence links to every accountable function.
Attach the product approval gate pre-launch condition list with current status.
Ask each function to arrive with a position rather than forming one in the room.
Done when every accountable function has received the pack ahead of the review.
verify: Reconcile the circulation list to the accountable function list.
Pass when every accountable function received the pack before the review.

steps.title: Review each readiness criterion against its evidence with the owning team
sop: Take each readiness criterion in turn and open its linked evidence in the meeting.
Confirm the recorded status with the team that owns the criterion.
Change any status the evidence does not support and record the change.
Done when every criterion has been reviewed against evidence and confirmed.
verify: Count criteria confirmed in the meeting against the assessment criterion count.
Pass when every criterion was reviewed and confirmed or amended.

steps.title: Confirm every product approval gate pre-launch condition is met or waived
sop: Take each pre-launch condition from the product approval gate in turn.
Confirm it is met with evidence or record a formal waiver with its rationale.
Identify who holds authority to waive each condition before accepting a waiver.
Done when every gate condition is marked met or formally waived.
verify: Filter the gate condition list for items neither met nor waived.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

steps.title: Take an explicit position from each accountable function
sop: Ask each accountable function for an explicit go, no-go, or go-with-conditions position.
Record the position against the named individual giving it.
Do not accept silence or abstention as a go position.
Done when every accountable function has given a recorded position.
verify: Count recorded positions against the accountable function list.
Pass when every function has a recorded position with a named individual.

steps.title: Record dissent and conditions with owners and dates
sop: Record every dissenting position with the reason given and the function holding it.
Record every condition attached to a go-with-conditions position.
Assign an owner and a due date to each condition before the meeting closes.
Done when every dissent and condition has an owner and a due date recorded.
verify: Filter the condition list for entries without an owner or a due date.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

steps.title: Close the review with a named approver taking the decision
sop: State the overall decision taking the recorded positions and conditions into account.
Name the approver who owns the decision and record their role.
State the effective date and the states in scope that the decision covers.
Done when the decision, approver, effective date, and state scope are stated in the meeting.
verify: Check the meeting record for the decision, named approver, date, and state scope.
Pass when all four are recorded and consistent with the positions taken.

steps.title: Publish the minutes and link them to the launch record in the PPM tool
sop: Write the minutes covering attendance, criterion review, positions, conditions, and decision.
Publish the minutes to the SharePoint launch record set with the date and version.
Link the minutes to the launch record in the PPM tool.
Done when the minutes are published and linked from the PPM launch record.
verify: Follow the PPM link and check the minutes show attendance and each function's position.
Pass when the link resolves and the minutes carry the approver and all positions.

generic.Defined scope/population: The servicing, claims, and contact centre teams in scope for the product launch.
generic.In-scope period: The readiness window from training completion to the launch-week roster publication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each confirmation carries the lead name, team, training completion rate, and roster reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: LMS completion counts reconcile to the in-scope headcount for each team.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written readiness confirmations retained with team, date, and the training report version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Teams below the training threshold logged with a remediation plan and completion date.
generic.Test population: All in-scope servicing, claims, and contact centre staff plus launch-week rosters.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No in-scope team below the agreed training completion threshold.
generic.Exception handling path: Shortfalls escalate to the Distribution Operations Manager for catch-up training or cover.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written readiness confirmation from each function with rosters covering the volume uplift.
generic.Evidence location: Readiness confirmations in the SharePoint launch record set with LMS completion reports attached.

steps.title: Establish the in-scope headcount per team
sop: Agree with each functional lead which roles are in scope for product training.
Record the in-scope headcount for servicing, claims, and contact centre.
Confirm the agreed training completion threshold for each team.
Done when each team has a recorded in-scope headcount and threshold.
verify: Compare the recorded headcount to the team establishment for each function.
Pass when each in-scope headcount is agreed by the functional lead.

steps.title: Run the training completion report from the learning management system
sop: Run the product training completion report by team from the learning management system.
Calculate the completion rate against the agreed in-scope headcount per team.
Export the report with its run date for the readiness evidence pack.
Done when each in-scope team has a dated completion rate from the LMS.
verify: Reconcile LMS enrolment counts against the agreed in-scope headcount per team.
Pass when enrolments reconcile to headcount with no unenrolled in-scope staff.

steps.title: Remediate teams below the training completion threshold
sop: List teams whose completion rate falls below the agreed threshold.
Book catch-up training for the named individuals still outstanding.
Re-run the completion report after the catch-up sessions.
Done when every team is at or above threshold or has a dated remediation plan.
verify: Compare the re-run completion rates against the agreed thresholds.
Pass when no in-scope team remains below its threshold.

steps.title: Verify launch-week rosters cover the forecast volume uplift
sop: Take the forecast volume uplift for the launch week from the launch plan.
Compare the published launch-week rosters against the forecast demand per team.
Confirm the hypercare rota sits on top of the base roster rather than replacing cover.
Done when every team roster covers the forecast uplift plus the hypercare rota.
verify: Compute rostered capacity against forecast volume for each launch-week day.
Pass when rostered capacity meets or exceeds forecast demand each day.

steps.title: Check claims screens, call scripts, and templates reference the new product
sop: Open the claims intake screens and confirm the new product appears with correct options.
Review the contact centre call scripts for accurate product terms and eligibility.
Check correspondence templates name the product and cite the correct form editions.
Done when screens, scripts, and templates have all been checked against the product spec.
verify: Raise a test claim and a test enquiry against the new product code.
Pass when both route correctly and present the new product content.

steps.title: Log readiness defects in the ITSM platform
sop: Raise an ITSM record for each screen, script, or template defect found.
Assign an owner and a due date ahead of the launch date to each record.
Re-check the affected item after each fix and close the record on evidence.
Done when every logged readiness defect is closed or formally accepted.
verify: Query open readiness defects linked to the launch in the ITSM platform.
Pass when no defect remains open without an acceptance decision.

steps.title: Obtain written readiness confirmation from each functional lead
sop: Send each servicing, claims, and contact-centre lead the training and roster evidence.
Request a written readiness confirmation naming the lead, team, and date.
File the confirmations in the SharePoint launch record set with the LMS reports.
Done when a written confirmation is held for each in-scope function.
verify: Count filed confirmations against the in-scope function list.
Pass when every in-scope function has a dated written confirmation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The launch decision statement plus every condition attached to it at the go/no-go review.
generic.In-scope period: From the go/no-go review date to the launch effective date the decision covers.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision record carries the decision, effective date, states in scope, and approver name.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracked actions raised equal the number of conditions recorded at the review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed decision record filed with version, decision date, and attendance list.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conditions falling due after the launch date flagged and re-dated or escalated.
generic.Test population: All conditions and all functional positions recorded at the go/no-go review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No launch condition without a named owner and a due date before launch.
generic.Exception handling path: Conditions without owners escalate to the Insurance Product Manager before filing the record.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed decision record filed with conditions tracked and positions attached.
generic.Evidence location: Signed record in the SharePoint governance repository linked from the PPM tool and GRC platform.

steps.title: Write the decision statement with effective date and state scope
sop: Write the decision as go, no-go, or go-with-conditions using the review outcome.
State the launch effective date and the states in scope for the decision.
Name the approver who took the decision and their role.
Done when the statement carries the decision, date, state scope, and approver.
verify: Compare the statement against the go/no-go minutes for consistency.
Pass when the decision, date, state scope, and approver match the minutes.

steps.title: List each condition with owner, due date, and closing evidence
sop: Extract every condition recorded at the go/no-go review.
Record the owner, the due date, and the evidence required to close each one.
Return any condition lacking an owner to the review chair for assignment.
Done when every condition carries an owner, a due date, and a closing evidence definition.
verify: Filter the condition list for entries missing an owner, date, or evidence definition.
Pass when the filtered list is empty.

steps.title: Attach the attendance list and each function's recorded position
sop: Take the attendance list and the recorded position of each function from the minutes.
Attach both to the decision record without summarising or merging positions.
Include any dissent verbatim as recorded at the review.
Done when the record carries the attendance list and every function's position.
verify: Count attached positions against the accountable function list.
Pass when every function's position is attached including any dissent.

steps.title: Raise a tracked action for each open condition in the PPM tool
sop: Raise a tracked action in the PPM tool for every open condition.
Set the owner and the due date to match the condition record.
Link each action back to the decision record so closure is traceable.
Done when every open condition has a linked tracked action in the PPM tool.
verify: Reconcile the count of tracked actions to the count of open conditions.
Pass when the counts reconcile and every action links to the decision record.

steps.title: Confirm no condition falls due after the launch date
sop: Compare each condition due date against the launch effective date.
Re-date any condition due after launch or escalate it as a launch blocker.
Record the reason for any date change against the condition.
Done when every condition is due on or before the launch date or is escalated.
verify: List conditions with a due date later than the launch effective date.
Pass when the list is empty or each entry carries a recorded escalation.

steps.title: File the signed decision record in the governance repository
sop: Obtain the approver signature on the completed decision record.
File the signed record in the SharePoint product governance repository.
Set the version and decision date properties on the filed document.
Done when the signed record is filed with its version and decision date.
verify: Open the filed record and check the signature, version, and decision date.
Pass when all three are present on the filed document.

steps.title: Link the decision record to the launch entry in the GRC platform
sop: Open the product launch entry in the GRC platform.
Add the signed decision record as the governance evidence reference.
Record the decision, approver, and effective date on the GRC entry fields.
Done when the GRC launch entry links to the signed decision record.
verify: Follow the GRC link and confirm it resolves to the signed decision record.
Pass when the link resolves and the GRC fields match the decision record.
